    • MODIFY

      public static final DefaultedRegistryReference<Operation> MODIFY
      An Operation that signifies the block change is particularly discernible as though the BlockState may be different but the BlockType may be the same. Or a congruency of changes that result to a "similar enough" change that the blocks share a very unique common trait.
